protocol.target_detail: forward downside-semivariance share = mean(min(r-mu,0)**2) / mean((r-mu)**2) over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-144
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_imb_z_k, own_dss_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher other-asset order-flow imbalance -> more downside-concentrated forward variance on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
